_comment: Moves The Upsider AI surplus out of the metagraph's custody address at ordinal 731649.
The wallet holds 145,335,256.25433419 UP while the pool book claims 73,629,031.67321414.
The difference, 71,706,224.58112005, is claimed by no pool. Sweeping it leaves the book
untouched, so the pool reaches reserve == wallet with no price movement.
The custody address has no private key, so this cannot be done as an ordinary transfer.
This is the only mechanism available.
IRREVERSIBLE. The destination cannot be recovered if it is wrong, for the same reason the
source cannot. Set it deliberately and check it twice. The node refuses to build the
snapshot while the placeholder is present.
